project_type: Google Apps Script Web App with HTML frontend
language: JavaScript (ES5 compatible - no ES6 modules, use var)
build_system: None - Google Apps Script files deployed directly via clasp or web editor
build_command: N/A - static files, syntax validation only
verification_instructions: Review code for correct syntax (ES5 compatible), proper function signatures matching google.script.run calls, and consistent UI patterns
setup_instructions: No setup needed - files are deployed directly to Google Apps Script
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no package downloads. All libraries must be loaded via CDN in HTML. Google Apps Script has no ES6 module support - use var, function declarations, no arrow functions in .gs files. Frontend can use modern JS within <script> tags as it runs in browser.
contribution_requirements: All backend code goes in .gs files using ES5 syntax. Frontend is a single Index.html with inline CSS/JS. Chart.js loaded via CDN.

key_patterns.backend_crud: Functions in Code.gs follow pattern: getRecords(query, filters), createRecord(data), updateRecord(rowId, data). Auth wrappers in Auth.gs add email parameter: createRecordAuth(email, data)
key_patterns.frontend_navigation: Single page app using show/hide with .page-content class. navigateTo(page) function toggles pages.
key_patterns.stats_pattern: getStats(filters) returns {total, ativos, emNegociacao, cancelados}. getSuspensosStats() returns {total, pendentes, pagos, vencidos}
key_patterns.inline_edit_pattern: Suspensos uses saveCell(rowId, col, value) calling updateSuspensosCellAuth
key_patterns.ui_pattern: Dark theme (bg-gray-900), cards with bg-gray-800 rounded-xl border border-gray-700 p-4, Tailwind CSS via CDN
key_patterns.status_badge_fn: stClass(s) returns tailwind classes for status badges
key_patterns.column_layout_cancelamentos: A=NOME DO ASSOCIADO, B=PLACA, C=VALOR DA PARCELA, D=VALOR PAGO, E=CONSULTOR, F=MOTIVO DO CANCELAMENTO, G=STATUS ATUAL, H=OBSERVACAO, I=ATENDENTE, J=DATA DE CRIACAO
key_patterns.column_layout_suspensos: A=ASSOCIADO, B=DATA RECEBIMENTO, C=DATA VENCIMENTO, D=PLACA, E=SITUACAO ATUAL, F=FORMA PGTO, G=VALOR RECEBIDO, H=VALOR ORIGINAL, I=ATENDENTE, J=OBSERVACOES, K=CONFERENCIA

directory_structure: apps-script/ contains all deployable files: Code.gs (backend CRUD + stats), Auth.gs (auth + permissions + audit), Index.html (full SPA frontend), ModalImport.html (import modal)
